notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello players! we have made it to a highlight in Shush's history. here's what we have added:
 - Bug fixes
 - Changed render pipeline (URP)
 - Performance optimizations
 - Changed foliage generation
 - Quick-hand items in inventory (Shift-click)
 - Better difficulty curve
 - New foliage (grass, trees, etc...)
 -- Underwater foliage
 - Fixed tree generation bugs
 - Added chests
 - Loot structures around the map
 -- Loot buildings
 -- Themed huts with blueprints
 - New crafting system
 -- Blueprints and workbench upgrades
 - Better info display and tool-tips
 - Item rarities. Colored outlines
 - Upgrade and crafting highlights (green can craft, red cant craft)

Here's what we are still working on:
 - (NOT DONE) Armor
 - (NOT DONE) A tutorial
 - (NOT DONE) missions
 - (NOT DONE) (POSSIBLY CANCELED) cutscenes
 - (NOT DONE) A city to traverse and find extra rare loot

Enjoy the new content and have fun ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE SOON
notes.notes:
We will be releasing A major update soon. With a lot of new features! 
This will bring us out of early access and we will also be setting a price for the game. (to be decided)
This update will include things like:

Performance optimizations
Convenience features
New foliage
New items (Amor, Chests, etc...)
Loot structures
New crafting system
And lots more!

We also have started working on a repo branch for multiplayer! This will be a long time in the future, and will NOT be part of this update.
The reasons for this are mainly funding and time.
